fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. The planner read internal/api/watchdog_unmerged.go and daemon_watchdog.go: watchdogReadPR finds a run's PR by its change set's branch and checks only that the PR body names the change set, so every ended run of a change set claims the change set's PR. That is how the plan run 01M6VY7E4JWY got the inbox item 'merge it by hand' for PR #376, which ship-change run 01M6WMX236BTT04TYQDACGKBZ4 owned and was being resumed toward its merge. The ship record (.git/rhiza/ship/<cs>.json) is per change set and names no run today. Two questions went to the arbiter, who ruled (assumed, would have escalated): the ownership check lives in the shared PR read, so the green-unmerged, CI-rerun and no-CI passes all see no PR for a run the ship record does not name; a record that names no run matches no run. The planner split the work into two leaves: ship steps record their run in the ship record, and the watchdog's PR read checks it, with the green-unmerged pass also skipping a change set with any live run or queued continue, as the intent asks.
fields.title: Plan of fix 01M6XB5: watchdog matches a PR only to the run that owns it (autonomous)
